proposals.ballotLanguage:
This proposal will permit the Authority to levy up to 1.75 mills, which would replace the 1.9239 mills authorized in August 2026 by the members of the Authority excluding Bay Township (that joined the Authority after the August election) for the purpose of providing funds for operating, equipping, and maintaining ambulance services within the territorial limits of the Authority for the years 2026-2028, inclusive. This question, if passed, would direct the collection of the above-referenced…
proposals.ballotLanguage:
This proposal will permit the Authority to levy up to 1.75 mills, which would replace the 1.9239 mills authorized in August 2026 by the members of the Authority excluding Bay Township (that joined the Authority after the August election) for the purpose of providing funds for operating, equipping, and maintaining ambulance services within the territorial limits of the Authority for the years 2026-2028, inclusive. This question, if passed, would direct the collection of the above-referenced millage rate in the Authority jurisdictions eligible for tax levies, including newly admitted Bay Township. If not passed, the August 2026 millage will remain in effect.
Shall the previous voted tax increase as authorized by Act 57 of 1988 of 1.9239 mills ($1.9239 per $1,000 of taxable value) on all taxable property within the prior territorial limits of the Lake Charlevoix Emergency Medical Service Authority (Hayes Township, Charlevoix Township, Marion Township, Norwood Township, and the City of Charlevoix, Charlevoix County, Michigan) be renewed and amended to levy a reduced up to 1.75 mills ($1.75 per $1,000 of taxable value) on all taxable value within the current territorial limits of the Authority (the jurisdictions above with the addition of Bay Township) for the same three (3) years, 2026 through 2028 inclusive, for the same purpose of providing funds for operating, equipping, and maintaining ambulance services within the territorial limits of the Authority, raising an estimated $2,430,179 in the first year the millage is levied?
proposals.officialTitle: Lake Charlevoix Emergency Medical Service Authority Proposal for Ambulance Operating Millage
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 1.75 mills for 2026–2028 — generally no increase over what you pay now, plus the restored or added amount described.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.
proposals.conservativeView: Renewals are the least disruptive way to keep a service funded, but every renewal is a chance to ask whether the service is delivering value. Watch for "renewal" proposals that quietly restore Headlee rollbacks — that is a tax increase.
proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.

The Township currently levies 0.2457 mills (originally 0.25 mills, rolled back by the Headlee Amendment) to support the Beaver Island Historical Society. This proposal would authorize an additional 0.2543 mills, bringing the total levy for the Historical Society to 0.5 mills.
